reasons: [coverage/major] D1 [criteriaAssessments C4; CL12, CL13; K12-K15; verdict] C4 asks for a quantified range of USD outcomes, hedged vs unhedged. The draft gives only sensitivities (USD 20k vs 80k per 0.01) and outcome spreads (USD 0.4M vs 1.6M) over an arbitrary ±0.10 band. It never shows USD proceeds at any rate, e.g. hedged = 6M x F + 2M x S_T vs unhedged = 8M x S_T at S_T = 1.02 / 1.12 / 1.22. The decision objective also asks for the forecast question to be framed as the forward plus a range of possible outcomes. No range of rates is given beyond the hypothetical ±0.10. Since no live implied vol was found (E17), the draft could have used a clearly labelled assumed vol, e.g. 7-9% annualised. That gives a 1-sigma move of about 5.4-6.9% over about 0.59 years, roughly ±0.06-0.08 around 1.12. Instead the ±0.10 band is not tied to any likelihood, so the treasurer cannot see how big a typical outcome is.
